_comment: Detached garage in the back lot behind 53 Prospect St (house 3914 on the overhead). Not legible in any Street View capture: the +u photo shows only a pale blur at the end of the driveway behind the fence, and the yellow lean-to in the -u photo belongs to 60 Genesee. Overhead: dark shingle gable, ridge along u (long axis), gable ends toward the road (+u) and the back lot (-u). Modelled plain: pale warm-grey siding with white trim to match the cream house, dark grey roof, two sectional doors on the +u gable end where the driveway arrives, a man door on the +v (driveway) side.
